# Lord Cleaning Services

> Lord Cleaning Services is a residential and commercial cleaning company in Northern Virginia. Every job is priced with a free, no-obligation quote. Cleaners are background-checked, trained in person and fully insured, and every visit is covered by a satisfaction guarantee.

- Website: https://lordcleaningservices.com
- Phone, text and WhatsApp: (571) 300-3094
- Email: trylordcleaning@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00 AM–6:00 PM; Saturday–Sunday 10:00 AM–5:00 PM
- Service area: Sterling, Reston, Ashburn, Leesburg, Herndon, Chantilly, Great Falls, McLean, Tysons, Vienna and nearby areas in Northern Virginia
- Languages: English and Spanish

## Get a free estimate

- [Book a cleaning / request a quote](https://lordcleaningservices.com/booking): choose a service, home size, date and time, and send the request. The team confirms the exact price before the visit.
- [Contact form](https://lordcleaningservices.com/#contact): short form for a quick estimate request.

## Services

- [Standard Cleaning](https://lordcleaningservices.com/services/standard): routine upkeep for houses, apartments, condos and townhomes.
- [Deep Cleaning](https://lordcleaningservices.com/services/deep): a top-to-bottom refresh that reaches every overlooked corner.
- [Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning](https://lordcleaningservices.com/services/move): a spotless handover for moving out or settling into a new place.
- [Office & Commercial Cleaning](https://lordcleaningservices.com/services/commercial): reliable cleaning for offices and workplaces, on a flexible schedule.
- [Post-Construction Cleaning](https://lordcleaningservices.com/services/construction): dust, debris and residue cleared after renovations and new builds.
- [Airbnb / Short-Term Rental Cleaning](https://lordcleaningservices.com/services/airbnb): fast, reliable turnovers between guests.

Recurring plans are available weekly, bi-weekly or monthly, as well as one-time cleanings.

## Policies

- Pricing: every home is quoted individually; there is no fixed public price list.
- Satisfaction guarantee: if anything is missed, the team returns the next day at no extra cost.
- Rescheduling: free up to 12 hours before the visit.
